cheapestNextMeasurements.name: Independent native tray-only versus full-menu once-trimmed control
cheapestNextMeasurements.method: Two fresh standalone processes with identical QApplication, VisualStyle, brand and QSystemTrayIcon; each settles and trims exactly once at the same age, one never constructs QMenu and one creates the full current menu. Root must schedule quiet runs; no run was started.
cheapestNextMeasurements.answers: How much of the observed 1.590 MiB whole-menu increment survives the existing startup trim?
cheapestNextMeasurements.acceptanceNeededBeforeProduction: Native first right-click menu opens once at correct position with every action; default trigger/double-click remains activity; native exported menu behavior on GNOME/KDE remains intact.

cheapestNextMeasurements.name: Mapped segment permissions plus same-toolchain size/IPO build comparison
cheapestNextMeasurements.method: Read-only readelf/stat already verified original measured binary SHA. Root can later record per-permission smaps for the resident executable and compare a standard Release -Os/IPO build under unchanged physical observer and contract/latency gates.
cheapestNextMeasurements.answers: Does shrinking reachable resident code/rodata recover meaningful RSS rather than disk-only symbol bytes?
cheapestNextMeasurements.currentStaticEvidence: Original measured binary .text size 0x191a0e; .bss only 0x268 bytes. Resident executable RSS 1.371 MiB is a ceiling, not predicted savings.

candidates.name: Defer whole tray QMenu until its first actual request
candidates.status: most grounded cold candidate; production experiment not authorized
candidates.evidence: 1.590 MiB standalone pre-trim menu increment; 1.117 MiB from constructing empty menu alone.
candidates.limits: Native APIs differ: Qt6.4.2 X11 mousePressEvent calls menu->popup before activated(Context), so merely assigning a menu in that signal misses first opening. Would need explicit native-supported popup for this route and retention after creation, with existing behavior on other routes. No backend or first-click runtime proof performed.

candidates.name: Standard Release size optimization and IPO for owned code
candidates.evidence: 1.371 MiB resident executable pages; current CMake uses default -O3 and no IPO. Exact measured binary hash was checked before readelf.
candidates.limits: Cannot save more than owned resident pages and will usually save much less. Keep distro Qt dynamic, official SDK pinning/module ABI build identity, C++20, contracts and measured latency. Debug/symbol stripping on disk does not imply RSS savings.

candidates.name: Preserve exact brand/custom icons with less eager painting or scale allocation
candidates.status: small conditional locator only; below main target
candidates.evidence: Brand icon stage touches 716,800 bytes (0.684 MiB), mostly QtGui code, for 69,200 additional allocated bytes. Menu icons are already included in candidate1.
candidates.limits: An exact pre-rendered brand asset or actual-DPR-only construction could avoid some first QPainter work, but QPixmap/native tray can touch the same code and decoder plugins. Avoid visual/DPR regression or new dependencies. No generated asset, product change or comparison was made; benefit may be zero. Do not add its menu savings to candidate1 twice.

rejectedOrLowPriority.name: Integer aliases or narrow operation/history IDs/counters
rejectedOrLowPriority.reason: Aliases have identical widths; toy narrowing retained padding and empty cold has no dense data. Signed32 conflicts with existing2GiB limit. Prior evidence disproved a cold opportunity.

rejectedOrLowPriority.name: Drop or globally replace native style/fonts/dialogs
rejectedOrLowPriority.reason: Explicitly disallowed. Existing same-binary style skip saved only753,664bytes and was rejected; preserve custom visuals.

rejectedOrLowPriority.name: More idle trim / allocator policy changes
rejectedOrLowPriority.reason: Product already performs guarded successful startup trim. Previous post-view trim reclaimed only126,976bytes of mostly live widgets; no new product-free-page proof.

rejectedOrLowPriority.name: Defer journal initialization or unload QtSql after startup
rejectedOrLowPriority.reason: Recovery/readiness/indexing are mandatory startup contracts. The entire current SQL closure is only1.613MiB and Qt plugin lifetime is not safely reducible by unloading an ordinary app object. Direct SQLite replacing QtSql alone would still keepSQLite and at most target0.383MiB of QtSql/plugin pages.

rejectedOrLowPriority.name: Late keychain/image-plugin cleanup
rejectedOrLowPriority.reason: Keychain0.109MiB and allthreeimageplugins0.129MiB; too small for5MiB and tied to preserved capabilities.

rejectedOrLowPriority.name: Post-view native surfaces
rejectedOrLowPriority.reason: Important separate root-owned work but allthreeviews are lazily absent in this cold workload; cannot claim their8MiBXorg/27MiBWayland allocations as cold saving.

rejectedOrLowPriority.name: Paid/new dependency/toolchain or moving cost to a helper
rejectedOrLowPriority.reason: Outside constraints; no helper savings may ignore total memory.

recommendation: Prioritize the once-trimmed whole-menu control, then owned Release size/IPO if root approves. This evidence does not support a cheap5MiB forecast or40MiB achievement; menu+executable accounting ceilings are below3MiB before overlap/realization. Do not invent another architecture change to fill the target.
furtherProbeRuns: None; quiet window released immediately after run001; root must schedule any repeat.
